name: 370.AI API
description:
OpenAI-compatible AI gateway — call OpenAI / Anthropic Claude / Google Gemini / Alibaba Qwen / ByteDance Doubao and more through a single API key and a single base URL.

**Auth**: send `Authorization: Bearer sk-...` on every request. Get a key at https://370.ai/register.

**Drop-in**: point any OpenAI SDK at the server URL below — no other change.

**Agents**: an MCP server is available at https://mcp.router.ai/mcp (official MCP Registry: `ai.router/ai-gateway`) with tools `list_models`, `chat`, `generate_image`, `text_to_speech`. Video generation is HTTP-only (`POST /v1/videos/generations`), not exposed over MCP.

Unified AI gateway — one API key for OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Alibaba Qwen, ByteDance Doubao and 100+ other models. OpenAI-compatible protocol, real-time usage billing, covering chat, image, video, embedding and speech.
